crossRefs.note: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down…
This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, Yahweh, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended…

translations.web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
translations.bsb: This is the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Judah.
